## Summary

Describe the problem and how this change addresses it. Link related issues.

## Affected apps

- [ ] Desktop (WPF)
- [ ] Web (Blazor)
- [ ] Documentation or repository tooling only

If shared behavior changed in only one app, explain why.

## Verification

List the build commands and manual checks you ran, along with their results.
For UI changes, include screenshots with personal information removed.
Note anything you could not verify.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I kept the change focused and updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I verified the affected apps, or explained verification limitations above.
- [ ] I considered whether the other app needs a matching change.
- [ ] I did not include OAuth configuration, tokens, credentials, personal app data, or generated build output.
